Definition
[Cauchy problem and Cauchy data] ↗ def:normal-derivative-notation 1. ch4:4.6.1-def-2\group Power Series Methods

Given $g_0,\ldots ,g_{k-1}:\Gamma \to \R $, the Cauchy problem prescribes \[ \frac{\partial ^ju}{\partial \nu ^j}=g_j\quad \text{on }\Gamma , \qquad j=0,\ldots ,k-1, \] along with the PDE.
